headline: 10-year yield jumped to 5.10%, oil rose on US-Iran uncertainty and Nvidia lost CEO Jensen Huang, leaving stocks lower into Nvidia earnings on Nov 17.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield closed near 5.10%, up about 10 bps, on renewed inflation worries.
fed: October inflation is still elevated while jobless claims are low, and the October FOMC minutes come out Wednesday Nov 18.
oil: December crude rose about 2.6% to $88.75 after Trump said the US no longer needs a deal with Iran, raising Strait of Hormuz risk.
geo: US-Iran diplomacy and Strait of Hormuz risk are driving energy prices; Nvidia's CEO resigned with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO.
